data.title: 和栗薰子 · 烘焙课后的窗口招手
data.description: 烘焙体验结束，薰子还穿着黄毛衣和棕围裙，站在教室临街窗口举起一袋自己做的饼干。黑紫色长发被方巾束好，她用空着的一只手轻轻挥挥，蓝眼里的笑意坦率明亮；这里是体验课堂，并非她家的店铺。
data.location: 烘焙体验教室临街窗口
data.action: 举起体验课做好的饼干袋，朝窗外轻轻挥手。
data.promptProse: Kaoruko Waguri stands at the baking-classroom street window after the workshop, raising a bag of her homemade cookies and waving with her free hand. Her yellow sweater and brown apron retain flour marks, blackish-purple braids gathered by a bandana. The medium portrait shows classroom worktables behind her, establishing a lesson setting. Soft frontal daylight lights blue eyes and the cookie bag, with window-frame shadows receding toward the room.
